properties.note: Farm calibration area for the ground-PV detector, drawn by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --farmland: a cropland-weighted random cell from cropland stratum 6 of 8: 45.7%-59.3% cropland (cell), then a 3 km window inside it whose own cropland share (61.2%, ESA WorldCover) is within 25% of the cell's (56.3%). Map ALL solar inside, ground and rooftop, tracing the panels rather than the fence. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-07-18 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2024-10-01 for a composite starting 2025-10-01. Register with new_calibration_quadrat.py --farm. Not checked on the ground: confirm it is mappable before you start, and do not move it toward visible solar.
